messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning to bump runtime, api, console, and sdk to v1.14 this week. Who wants to own changelogs & tags? Need a cutover window on Friday 16:00 UTC. @jon @liam @priya
jon: I can take API + runtime tags and release PRs. Will do annotated tags and run changelog script. Any breaking changes to call out?
liam: Console side: just a dependency pin for react -> 17.1, and a tiny migration script. No breaking API.
priya: I can own SDK packaging & publish. Question: do we treat the client change as minor or patch? It adds a convenience helper but no breaking API.
maya: Treat it as a minor for SDK (semver bump minor). Runtime/API = minor too since there are a couple of new endpoint params but backward compatible. Cutoff for code freeze: EOD Thursday (UTC).
engineering-bot: CI status summary: runtime-integration ✅, api-tests flaky (2/3) — investigating, console-ci queued.
jon: Tagging plan (what I'll run):
```bash
# per repo
git checkout release-branch
git pull origin release-branch
git tag -a v1.14.0 -m "release v1.14.0"
git push origin v1.14.0
# generate changelog
./scripts/generate-changelog --since v1.13.0 > CHANGELOG.md
```
Also will create release PRs that include the generated changelogs.
liam: Console will need a short migration note in the changelog about the small init change. I'll add it to the PR body.
priya: npm publish plan: bump package.json -> run canary -> CI passes -> npm publish --tag latest. I'll coordinate canary URL here before publish.
maya: Small ask: add a one-line "compatibility" note in each repo's changelog (e.g., "compatible with runtime v1.14"). Helps customers and support.
release-council: Quick policy reminder: open security-review ticket if any dependency update touches native modules. Also add the label `release-type: minor` on PRs so release tooling picks them up. Cutoff enforcement: after Thu EOD only hotfixes allowed and require release-council approval.
jon: Done tagging for api + runtime. Release PRs: <https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/412> and <https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/789> :rocket:
liam: Console PR up: <https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/54> — migration note in description, tests green locally.
priya: SDK PR posted and canary run scheduled. Will publish after we get one clean canary. PR: <https://github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/210>
maya: Great. I'll coordinate the Friday rollout and watch canaries. If anything blocks the freeze window, ping me directly or drop the blocker here. :thumbsup:
jon: sgtm
liam: thanks, will monitor console CI
priya: will ping when publish is live
engineering-bot: Reminder scheduled: code-freeze in 36 hours (Thu EOD UTC).
